title: CX Embedded PC with TwinCAT 3
summary: PC-based controller running the TwinCAT 3 runtime with EtherCAT Terminal I/O.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: A CX Embedded PC sits on the DIN rail with a power supply and an EtherCAT coupler; EL terminals follow on the right. TwinCAT 3 programs are IEC 61131-3 and run in real-time tasks.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: Choose the profile `beckhoff.twincat3` for a Free Lab project to see I/O as linked terminal channels such as `Term 2 (<terminal>).Channel 1.Input`, and analog raw values 0..32767 for the nominal range. The PLC is still PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are PLC Lab Structured Text, not the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog values use 0..32767 for the nominal range
EtherCAT is not simulated; terminals behave like local modules
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
